detected_fault: Kernel Security Check Failure with Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) and cursor disappearance issue
suggested_solution: Remove one RAM stick to isolate the issue.
Run a system maintenance check using the Control Panel (System and Security > Security Maintenance).
Create a bootable USB drive with an anti-virus program (e.g., ESET) to scan for any malware or viruses.
Check CPU temperatures to rule out overheating as a cause.
